title: Variable spoken-values time is awesome, but...
symptom: The user requests that the rate of change minimum for spoken glucose values be changed from 4 to 2 mg/dl/min, as 4 is too large a rate of change. They believe most CGM software allows for 2 or 3 mg/dl/min and they prefer 2 for quicker alerts.
cause: The user initially misunderstood the setting, thinking it was based on rate of change. The maintainer clarified that the setting is based on absolute value change since the last spoken reading, not rate of change.
fix: The maintainer explained that the setting is not rate-of-change based but absolute value change; the user accepted this explanation and no code change was made. The user later reported a possible issue with the triggering behavior, but no fix was confirmed.
evidence_quote: The speak readings glucose threshold is not based on rate of change, it is based on absolute value since the last spoken reading.
